notes.title: Update 1.3 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

After a few weeks of beta testing, we are happy to announce that version 1.3 is now live for everyone. Thank you all so much for the feedback!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🟣Version 1.3 Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Resolved several issues to ensure smoother gameplay.
[*] [b]Optimized Framerate:[/b] Shaders now prewarm in multiple configurations, reducing on-the-fly creation during gameplay.
[*] [b]Memory & Lightning:[/b] Improved memory management for lightmaps and boosted overall lighting system performance.
[*] [b]New Quality Setting:[/b] In addition to the previous high and low options, a medium quality level is now available, offering a balanced experience for players seeking an optimal mix of visual fidelity and performance.[/list]
[h3]🆕New Community-Requested Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Refined Input Mapping:[/b] Experience more intuitive controls with updated mapping.
[*] [b]Enhanced Stick Responsiveness:[/b] Adjusted dead zone settings for better analog stick precision.
[*] [b]Quick Level Restart:[/b] Added a dedicated button for fast and easy level resets, in addition to the checkpoint loading feature.
[*] [b]Customizable Control Layout:[/b] Now includes a dominant hand setting, allowing you to choose your preferred dominant hand for a more personalized gaming experience.[/list]
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Undead Citadel Update 1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey Undead Citadel players on Steam!

We are thrilled to announce that the latest update (version 1.2) has successfully completed its beta phase and is now live for all devices! This significant update includes major improvements such as an updated engine, enhanced audio, better performance, refined controls, and more realistic weapon movements. We appreciate your patience and feedback during the beta period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474068/0a3a10dba247688dfad84d845704d6dc341b980a.png[/img]

To celebrate the update and the ongoing Steam Summer Sale, Undead Citadel is now available at a 30% discount until July 11, 2024. Don't miss out on this great deal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474068/015d649b89e20d989c51ca6885ffcca8fd9cfd02.jpg[/img]

If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please let us know here, on our Discord, or via email at info@darkcurry.com. Your input is invaluable as we continue to enhance the game.

For those who prefer the previous version, it remains accessible via the "previous build" channel.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the new and improved Undead Citadel!

Catch you in the game,
The Undead Citadel Team

notes.title: Update: Undead Citadel v1.0.1
notes.notes:
We are so glad to be getting so much feedback from you all. Your input has been invaluable in helping us identify areas for improvement in Undead Citadel. We truly appreciate your support and the time you have taken to share your thoughts and suggestions.
Rest assured, we are committed to making Undead Citadel the best combat experience possible. We have been diligently working on implementing the feedback we received, and the result is Undead Citadel v1.0.1. However, our work doesn't stop here.

Here are some of the notable changes you can expect in this version

[b]Improved latency in hand movements and rotations[/b]

We have improved the algorithm for hand movement, making them move more realistically. Now, hands don’t go away when the player rotates fast smoothly. They are also less floaty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474068/78387dc8290f20e60efb9078cb41f59f11eb964f.gif[/img]

This is one of a bunch of improvements we are preparing to improve the latency and improving the physics in the game so expect more improvements to come really soon. Contact us if you want to have anticipated access to our tests and help us to make it better.

[b]Improved parry detection[/b]
Based on your suggestions we have made parry a little bit easier by increasing the parry angle and the timing window.

[b]Added ambient sounds in previously quiet areas[/b]
We listened to your feedback about quiet areas, so we added more sounds and fixed some bugs about other audios.

[b]Addressed impact feedback issues with certain attacks[/b]
In base of your comments we also managed some problems with the impact feedback, making them feel better.

[b]Physics adjustments synchronized with the computer's framerate.[/b]
For some of you, one of the causes that added a floaty feeling to the game was a low framerate. Now we will adjust the physics framerate to your computer possibilities.
However you can still manually adjust other values such as shadows, terrain quality and render scale until you find a good balance between quality and performance.

[b]Other changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized terrain for smoother gameplay.
[*] Tweaked LOD (Level of Detail) objects for improved performance.
[*] Modified hitboxes for unarmed and grounded enemies.
[*] Fixed combat music that failed to start or remained active after battles.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]
We have changed the Steam controller assignments. If you have overwritten them, please revert to the default values and then make your changes again. Otherwise, the hands may appear displaced.

We have [b]more exciting improvements in the pipeline[/b] that are almost ready to be released. These upcoming updates will further enhance the combat mechanics and optimize performance. We can't wait to share them with you!
If you would like to have early access to our tests and be a part of shaping the future updates, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Once again, thank you for your valuable feedback and for being a part of the Undead Citadel community. Your support motivates us to keep pushing boundaries and creating an exceptional gaming experience for all our players.
